verdict.supported_in_model: A slower matter component can reduce the propagation rate of a coherent light-matter hybrid. The reduced fast-sector equation then contains an exact delayed memory/self-energy generated by the matter sector.
verdict.necessary_correction: The tail is not a single electron trailing a photon in space. Direct coherent mixing is naturally with neutral material excitations/polarization (excitons, collective atomic coherence, plasmons, etc.).
verdict.kakeya_link: Only photonic directions outside ker(V^dagger) are loaded by matter. rank(V) bounds how many independent fast directions can be controlled through a finite matter sector.
verdict.brake_control: Damping is a lossy brake and shortens coherent memory. Reversible control is better represented by changing coupling, detuning, or a long-lived matter coherence.
verdict.not_established: No new vacuum-light law, photon mass, electron-photon tether in empty space, or derivation of c.
